Website Accessibility

Access matters here.

We aim to make this website useful for people who use assistive technology and a wide range of devices.

Our accessibility target

This website is designed with WCAG 2.2 Level AA as its target. A conformance assessment has not been completed.

Using the website

  • Use the “Skip to main content” link at the start of each page to bypass navigation.
  • Navigate links and buttons with your keyboard. On smaller screens, open the Menu button to reveal navigation; Escape closes it.
  • Text and layouts are designed to resize and reflow. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
  • The website follows the light or dark appearance preference supplied by your browser or operating system.
  • The contact page displays our email address as a link you can activate or copy into your preferred email service, along with our phone number.
  • Use the English and Español links in the header to open the equivalent page in the other language.

Report an access barrier

If something prevents you from using the website, email info@elevateaccess.us or call (510) 224‑5251. It helps to include the page, the task you were trying to complete, and your browser or assistive technology if you wish.

Practical accessibility and assistive technology support for individuals and organizations.
